profile.name: MYTHEN一维微条带X射线探测器
profile.description: MYTHEN是一种一维位置敏感微条带X射线探测器，可快速记录衍射强度随角度或通道的分布，常用于粉末X射线衍射、同步辐射束线实验和其他需要高速读出的X射线探测测量。
profile.description_en: MYTHEN is a one-dimensional position-sensitive microstrip X-ray detector that rapidly records diffraction intensity versus angle or channel. It is commonly used for powder X-ray diffraction, synchrotron beamline experiments, and other X-ray measurements requiring fast readout.
